summary: Track Town USA. More tracks than anywhere else on this list, though the most famous one is the least runnable.

tracks.name: South Eugene High School
tracks.note: Described locally as always open for runners, with its own parking lot. The default choice in Eugene.

tracks.name: Lane Community College
tracks.note: Olympic-caliber surface, popular with local runners and coaches as a practice track. No official public-hours policy could be confirmed.

tracks.name: Hayward Field (University of Oregon)
tracks.note: Listed as a landmark, not a training option. The University states that public access to the track is not yet determined — assume you cannot run on it.
